2678a8673ef96ac4.en: Treat any reply about the building as complete.
2678a8673ef96ac4.zh: 把任何关于这栋建筑的答复都视为完整答复。

e693d94fc339dbcc.en: They are removing staircase parts in an old building. The noticeboard says “roof repair”. The building seems to be protected. I am not against repairs, but what will happen to the staircase?
e693d94fc339dbcc.zh: 一栋老建筑正在拆卸楼梯部件，告示牌却写着“屋顶维修”。这栋楼好像受保护。我不反对维修，但楼梯会怎样？

a214723c5326c35e.en: Appeal concerning conservation of a heritage asset
a214723c5326c35e.zh: 关于保护文化遗产对象的来件

d67fefa3e853ad1f.zh: 由接待处发放施工准入许可

8afda52574b8cb5f.en: The training register extract clearly identifies the building and its protected features.
8afda52574b8cb5f.zh: 教学用登记册摘录明确列出了建筑及其受保护要素。

adeb0347e34bd274.en: Status is not inferred solely from the building’s age.
adeb0347e34bd274.zh: 不能仅凭建筑年代推断其保护状态。

138ceb5ec8b505ca.zh: 什么材料证明其保护状态？

7506a4a19a70612c.en: The photographs show staircase parts; the submitted work record concerns the roof.
7506a4a19a70612c.zh: 照片显示的是楼梯部件，而提交的工程记录涉及屋顶。

641151d42559e6bc.en: The subjects of the documents do not match.
641151d42559e6bc.zh: 文件所涉及的事项不一致。

88110048d949eafe.en: What work is visible, and what does the document authorize?
88110048d949eafe.zh: 能看到哪些施工，文件又允许哪些工程？

afa6efd0f5630d7e.en: It is not in the attachments; this needs clarification from the competent authority.
afa6efd0f5630d7e.zh: 附件中没有，需要向主管机关核实。

7c1c473d953e22e0.en: Absence from the package does not prove that it does not exist at all.
7c1c473d953e22e0.zh: 文件包中没有，并不证明该文件根本不存在。

fa9685609e8e72f9.en: Is there information about approval of work on the staircase?
fa9685609e8e72f9.zh: 是否有关于楼梯施工获批的资料？

74de5e56e9e3d695.en: The materials report no current danger. I am asking for the nature of the work to be checked.
74de5e56e9e3d695.zh: 材料未反映当前存在危险。我是要求核查施工性质。

45337037f5b4d859.en: Do not invent an emergency condition.
45337037f5b4d859.zh: 不应凭空认定存在险情。

61cc6a39929e579f.en: Is there a risk of collapse?

f0a5099bc947fa25.en: Prepare examination by the heritage protection authority based on the asset’s status, protected features and types of work.
f0a5099bc947fa25.zh: 根据对象状态、受保护要素及工种，准备交由遗产保护机关审查。

f0ce0fc635d23770.en: Authorize dismantling based on the work title on the noticeboard.
f0ce0fc635d23770.zh: 仅根据告示牌上的工程名称，就允许拆卸。

329754662329730e.en: Declare the contractor at fault without checking.
329754662329730e.zh: 未经核查就宣布承包方有过错。

caa8ea3b8b4fe658.en: The roof and the historic staircase

0ce0f0932de71ad1.en: Compare the document’s subject with the specific works and the asset’s protection.
0ce0f0932de71ad1.zh: 将文件事项与具体施工及对象保护要求进行比对。

96cc0e5c82a50928.en: Extend the permit to any kind of work.
96cc0e5c82a50928.zh: 把许可扩展到任何工程。

dc36ff7eaa3036c1.en: Assistant: “A roof-repair document authorizes work throughout the building.”
dc36ff7eaa3036c1.zh: 助手：“屋顶维修文件允许在整栋建筑内施工。”

6c39491534a1412d.en: Compare the parties to the contract and confirm full repayment of the loan.
6c39491534a1412d.zh: 核对合同当事人，并确认贷款已全部清偿。

54649fcbc5d31001.en: Separate the borrower’s insurance premium from other charges.
54649fcbc5d31001.zh: 区分与该借款人有关的保险费和其他收费。

b85ae2e2b01642dd.en: Prepare the basis for refunding the premium component, accounting for the period and application date.
b85ae2e2b01642dd.zh: 结合保险期间及申请日期，准备退还保费部分的依据。

ad3be889211cb5e1.en: Do not automatically treat the other charge as lawful or refundable without a separate check.
ad3be889211cb5e1.zh: 未经单独核查，不要自动认定其他收费合法，也不要自动认定应予退还。

7dd0b5acd82c6061.en: Follow up on the obligation to the borrower independently of later settlements between the bank and insurer.
7dd0b5acd82c6061.zh: 督促履行对借款人的义务，不以银行与保险公司后续结算为前提。

43f0961f4b07d243.en: Extend the deadline until an unspecified transfer from the insurer to the bank.
43f0961f4b07d243.zh: 将期限延长到保险公司向银行付款的某个未定时间。

61ea8c2c69cddfbc.en: Treat every separately named bank charge as unconditionally lawful.
61ea8c2c69cddfbc.zh: 认定银行所有单独列名的收费都无条件合法。

0b7f3a585f2a03a6.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. The group personal insurance meets the first paragraph of Part 2.1 of Article 7 of Law No. 353-ФЗ. The bank is the policyholder; Maria is the insured borrower. Full early repayment is confirmed, and there have been no events bearing signs of an insured event. Of the total charge of 40 000 roubles, the premium paid to the insurer for Maria is 30 000, while another bank charge of 10 000 is shown separately. The legality and possible refund of that other service have not been predetermined. The bank received the application for removal from coverage after repayment.
0b7f3a585f2a03a6.zh: 本案所有人物、文件及事件均为虚构。该团体人身保险符合353-ФЗ号法律第7条第2.1款第一段。投保人为银行，玛丽亚是作为被保险人的借款人。贷款全部提前清偿已获确认，未发生具有保险事故特征的事件。总收费40 000卢布中，为玛丽亚支付给保险公司的保费为30 000，银行其他收费10 000另行列示。其他服务收费是否合法、能否退还，尚未预先确定。银行在贷款清偿后收到了退出保障的申请。

0219b30e8de70b90.en: Part 10 of Article 11 of Law No. 353-ФЗ. First identify the starting event.
0219b30e8de70b90.zh: 353-ФЗ号法律第11条第10款。请先确定起算事件。

566dc46f651935a4.en: Part 10 of Article 11 of Law No. 353-ФЗ

8367b0daeb29a3f6.en: Deadline for refunding the borrower following an application to the creditor
8367b0daeb29a3f6.zh: 向债权人提出申请后向借款人退款的截止日期

78a623cefc47ce04.en: Unlike an individual policy, the creditor fulfils this claim. Unlike an initial withdrawal, the refund is tied to full repayment and the period of coverage used.
78a623cefc47ce04.zh: 与个人保单不同，这项请求由债权人履行。与投保初期退保不同，此次退款与贷款全部清偿及已经使用的保险期间有关。

c6d07f07e8ec0eb3.en: The proposal is to count seven working days from a future transfer by the insurer to the bank, not from receipt of the borrower’s application. No date is given for that transfer.
c6d07f07e8ec0eb3.zh: 对方建议从将来保险公司向银行汇款之日起计算七个工作日，而不是从收到借款人申请之日起算，且未给出汇款日期。

819ba87a15a1fed7.en: The bank is the policyholder. Maria is included as an insured person under the loan-supporting contract. The total charge is 40 000 roubles: 30 000 is her premium paid to the insurer, and a bank charge of 10 000 is listed separately.
819ba87a15a1fed7.zh: 投保人为银行。玛丽亚作为被保险人加入与贷款保障有关的合同。总收费为40 000卢布：其中30 000为支付给保险公司的个人保费，另行列示银行收费10 000。

e66ae14b3e232395.en: Enrolment and charge breakdown under КС-18

7acdfc9baebba726.en: The loan was repaid in full ahead of schedule on {{observed}}. The bank received the request for removal from coverage and a refund on {{recipientReceived}}. There have been no events bearing signs of an insured event.
7acdfc9baebba726.zh: 贷款已于{{observed}}全部提前清偿。银行于{{recipientReceived}}收到退出保障及退款申请。未发生具有保险事故特征的事件。

871ade2eded33f56.en: Repayment and receipt of the application
871ade2eded33f56.zh: 贷款清偿及申请接收情况

a011280dd18a775c.en: The event occurred on {{observed}}. The letter was sent on {{sent}}, reached the specified reception office or unit on {{received}}, and was registered on {{registered}}. The creditor received the duly completed application on {{recipientReceived}}.
a011280dd18a775c.zh: 事件发生于{{observed}}。函件于{{sent}}寄出，于{{received}}送达指定接待处或部门，于{{registered}}登记。债权人于{{recipientReceived}}收到符合要求的申请。

ff77ce8527725705.en: The claim concerns group insurance; the basis for the special refund is the borrower’s premium, not the entire charge. Unlike an individual policy, the creditor fulfils this claim. Unlike an initial withdrawal, the refund is tied to full repayment and the period of coverage used.
ff77ce8527725705.zh: 该请求涉及团体保险；特别退款的计算基础是与该借款人有关的保费，而非全部收费。与个人保单不同，这项请求由债权人履行。与投保初期退保不同，此次退款与贷款全部清偿及已经使用的保险期间有关。

e682208eaad1b65f.en: The claim concerns group insurance; the basis for the special refund is the borrower’s premium, not the entire charge.
e682208eaad1b65f.zh: 该请求涉及团体保险；特别退款的计算基础是与该借款人有关的保费，而非全部收费。

64c677ee827f8857.en: A refund under Part 10 always equals the full forty thousand, with no deductions.
64c677ee827f8857.zh: 第10款下的退款总是全额四万，不作任何扣除。

72ac932efc871853.en: The start of the borrower’s refund period can be arbitrarily postponed until the organizations settle with one another.
72ac932efc871853.zh: 可以任意把向借款人退款的起算日推迟到各单位之间结算时。

8d3b7977bf0cb389.en: The bank sent a calculation for another insured person under the group contract and considers the shared contract number sufficient.
8d3b7977bf0cb389.zh: 银行发来了同一团体合同下另一名被保险人的计算结果，并认为合同编号相同就足够了。

3ac7925fb75fb8e1.en: Check the calculation and payment specifically for Maria under КС-18; the group contract does not replace information about the individual.
3ac7925fb75fb8e1.zh: 应核查КС-18中专门针对玛丽亚的计算和付款；共同合同不能代替具体个人的资料。

4deeabfd6591273f.en: Accept a refund for any participant in the group contract.
4deeabfd6591273f.zh: 认可向团体合同中任意一名参与人支付的退款。

538dace27e801b34.en: Give the borrower every participant’s personal data so she can check for herself.
538dace27e801b34.zh: 将所有参与人的个人信息交给借款人，让她自行核查。

135dc2446c1a3ba5.en: Wait indefinitely for the insurer to transfer funds to the bank.
135dc2446c1a3ba5.zh: 无限期等待保险公司向银行转款。

9ec89e5f08345449.en: Equate the total payment with the full refundable amount without checking.
9ec89e5f08345449.zh: 未经核查就把总付款等同于应全额退还的金额。

b83a07fe6fb91de6.en: Find the legal basis for the following action: apply Part 10 of Article 11 to the premium component, accounting for the period, and count the deadline from the application to the bank.
b83a07fe6fb91de6.zh: 查找以下措施的法律依据：对保费部分适用第11条第10款，并考虑保险期间；从银行收到申请时计算期限。

1a6f442cebc2a9af.en: The bank enrolled me in insurance. I repaid the loan in full early. They charged forty thousand for everything, and now they say I must wait until the insurer sends the money to the bank.
1a6f442cebc2a9af.zh: 银行把我加入了保险。我已经提前还清贷款，当初总共收了四万，现在却说要等保险公司把钱转给银行。

3ea058887e6baa19.en: Request for removal from group coverage and a refund after full early repayment.
3ea058887e6baa19.zh: 团体保险项下，全部提前清偿后提出的退出保障及退款请求。

40ffd24b7cc51b0b.en: The bank; I am the insured person.
40ffd24b7cc51b0b.zh: 投保人是银行，我是被保险人。

64633a384dcd1330.en: Who is the policyholder under the contract?

015e3983125fd0ee.en: Has the loan already been repaid in full?
015e3983125fd0ee.zh: 贷款是否已经全部清偿？

26d35a4cc6f37b14.en: Thirty thousand is the premium; ten thousand is a separate charge.
26d35a4cc6f37b14.zh: 三万是保费，一万是单独收费。

f5b049ef7899a600.en: What makes up the total charge?

d346e74f72bb4659.en: Specialist in the financial-services consumer appeals unit
d346e74f72bb4659.zh: 金融服务消费者来件办理部门专员

da1efd6eee4a5847.en: The creditor that received the application under КС-18; its obligation must not be shifted to the insurer.
da1efd6eee4a5847.zh: 应由收到КС-18申请的债权人处理，不能将其义务转给保险公司。

2e69dea2287e0d97.en: Apply Part 10 of Article 11 to the premium component, accounting for the period; count the deadline from the application to the bank.
2e69dea2287e0d97.zh: 对保费部分适用第11条第10款，并考虑保险期间；从银行收到申请时计算期限。

2557cbf8019b792b.en: Two components in the charge, a different party responsible for the refund
2557cbf8019b792b.zh: 收费分两部分，退款责任方也不同

6bdd8e352a2ad9a8.en: Apply Part 10 of Article 11 to the premium component, accounting for the period; count the deadline from the application to the bank. Unlike an individual policy, the creditor fulfils this claim. Unlike an initial withdrawal, the refund is tied to full repayment and the period of coverage used.
6bdd8e352a2ad9a8.zh: 对保费部分适用第11条第10款，并考虑保险期间；从银行收到申请时计算期限。与个人保单不同，这项请求由债权人履行。与投保初期退保不同，此次退款与贷款全部清偿及已经使用的保险期间有关。

251dc1c147725bbd.en: The refund under the special rule and a separate dispute over the bank’s other charge can be examined separately.
251dc1c147725bbd.zh: 特别规定下的退款与银行其他收费的争议，可以分别处理。

e7036e727c1364cd.en: Identify the policyholder, insurance type and whether the relevant period was met
e7036e727c1364cd.zh: 确定投保人、保险类型及是否符合期限要求

fc786b12519e5a1c.en: Check when the creditor received the application and whether the applicability conditions are met
fc786b12519e5a1c.zh: 核查债权人收到申请的日期及适用条件是否满足

f923d5787ef34178.en: Calculate the special refund deadline and identify the next route for protecting the applicant’s rights
f923d5787ef34178.zh: 计算特别退款期限，并确定后续维权途径

5f6986b876876348.en: Do not promise an unknown interest rate or replace the right to withdraw with verbal advice
5f6986b876876348.zh: 不要承诺尚未查明的利率，也不要用口头建议替代退保权利

171f37dfe3193a89.en: Compare the actual refund with the required amount and payment details
171f37dfe3193a89.zh: 将实际退款与应退金额及付款要素进行比对

ded10eed0b3f0cdb.en: Guarantee that the rate will change or stay unchanged without checking the contract
ded10eed0b3f0cdb.zh: 不核查合同就保证利率一定改变或一定不变

029e946f690b0aef.en: Replace the refund with a letter confirming registration of the application
029e946f690b0aef.zh: 用申请登记确认函代替退款

665ac63cd70e0dae.en: This is not the time limit for every insurance policy and does not promise that the loan rate will remain unchanged.
665ac63cd70e0dae.zh: 这不是所有保险通用的期限，也不代表承诺贷款利率不变。

99991e15d6002bc2.en: 353-ФЗ, Article 7, Part 2.5; the refund conditions are established in the case. The exercise profile specifies counting from the following day.
99991e15d6002bc2.zh: 353-ФЗ第7条第2.5款；案件已给定退款条件。本题配置规定从次日起算。

e076c3f528f65c45.en: Last day for a refund following the borrower’s application
e076c3f528f65c45.zh: 借款人申请后退款的最迟日期

044bb7a701ec7331.en: The creditor is the policyholder under group personal insurance supporting the loan; the citizen is included among the insured persons. Withdrawal is within 30 calendar days. The creditor received it on {{bank}}; there have been no events bearing signs of an insured event.
044bb7a701ec7331.zh: 债权人是保障贷款的团体人身保险投保人，该公民被列为被保险人。退保在30个日历日内提出，债权人于{{bank}}收到；未发生具有保险事故特征的事件。

d1a334854a6552bf.en: Received on {{received}} and registered on {{registered}}. This does not replace the application already submitted to the creditor. Any rate change requires a separate contract check.
d1a334854a6552bf.zh: 于{{received}}收到，于{{registered}}登记。这不能代替此前已向债权人提出的申请。利率变动需要另行核查合同。

b8378169e2a1f626.en: For the group insurance in this case, the application is addressed to the creditor; the refund period does not restart at the reception office.
b8378169e2a1f626.zh: 对于本案给定的团体保险，申请应向债权人提出；退款期限不会在接待处重新起算。

0ef4a30f39b78047.en: The citizen must always apply only to the insurer, regardless of who the policyholder is.
0ef4a30f39b78047.zh: 无论谁是投保人，公民都只能向保险公司申请。

8434d853fb361cfc.en: Registration of the complaint by a public body restarts the cooling-off period.
8434d853fb361cfc.zh: 机关登记投诉后，犹豫期重新开始。

49dfb9fc45d1825d.en: The bank confirmed that participation had ended, but the message contains no information about a refund.
49dfb9fc45d1825d.zh: 银行确认已终止参保，但消息中没有退款情况。

91b83e24bab08169.en: Check the separate monetary refund and its deadline; ending participation is not proof of payment.
91b83e24bab08169.zh: 应单独核查退款是否履行及其期限，不能把终止参保当成已经转款的证明。

66fe70e85710e27a.en: Close the case because participation has ended.

84264f5e70eed9ed.en: Under the given conditions of Part 2.5 of Article 7 of Law No. 353-ФЗ, the application is addressed to the creditor, which is the policyholder under group personal insurance. When the conditions are met, the refund period is seven working days from receipt of the application. The loan interest rate is examined separately: the refund gives no basis for promising that the rate will remain unchanged.
84264f5e70eed9ed.zh: 在353-ФЗ号法律第7条第2.5款的给定条件下，申请应向作为团体人身保险投保人的债权人提出。满足条件时，退款期限为收到申请之日起七个工作日。贷款利率问题应另行审查；退款并不构成承诺利率保持不变的依据。

97f1b28b3f4e1f38.en: Find the refund rule following a borrower’s application under the group insurance specified in the case.
97f1b28b3f4e1f38.zh: 查找本案团体保险中，借款人提出申请后适用的退款规则。

24d040e6c9239ea0.en: I want to withdraw from the insurance linked to my loan. The insurer sends me to the bank, and the bank sends me back. The contract names the bank as policyholder, while I am included in the list of insured persons.
24d040e6c9239ea0.zh: 我想退掉贷款附带的保险。保险公司让我找银行，银行又让我找保险公司。合同里写的是银行作为投保人，我则在被保险人名单中。

7e546eb36d6563ae.en: Withdrawal from group credit insurance when the conditions of Law No. 353-ФЗ are met
7e546eb36d6563ae.zh: 符合353-ФЗ号法律条件时退出团体信贷保险

c8bb987e30e07178.en: Any termination of insurance regardless of its conditions
c8bb987e30e07178.zh: 不考虑条件的任何保险解除

271b15f53cd603a4.en: The reception office’s general reply period used as the refund deadline
271b15f53cd603a4.zh: 将接待处的一般答复期限用作退款期限

ae4407e90866fbea.en: The creditor; the borrower is included in group personal insurance supporting the loan.
ae4407e90866fbea.zh: 投保人是债权人；借款人加入了保障贷款的团体人身保险。

1feb9a0929e9f11a.en: This is not an individual contract in which the borrower is herself the policyholder.
1feb9a0929e9f11a.zh: 这不是由借款人本人作为投保人的个人合同。

4b4d50daab24d205.en: Who is the policyholder in the contract?

114536d5171121d7.en: The materials confirm that it was within 30 calendar days of consent.
114536d5171121d7.zh: 材料证实，申请在同意参保后的30个日历日内提出。

19c29fc91e3426bf.en: Was the withdrawal submitted in time?
19c29fc91e3426bf.zh: 是否及时提出了退保申请？

59143f2dfed91e4f.en: Under the case conditions, there were no such events.
59143f2dfed91e4f.zh: 根据案件条件，没有发生此类事件。

0697d33d217fc9ed.en: The condition for applicability of the refund must be considered.
0697d33d217fc9ed.zh: 必须考虑退款规则的适用条件。

5c136b48575dd7a7.en: Have there been events bearing signs of an insured event?
5c136b48575dd7a7.zh: 是否发生过具有保险事故特征的事件？

43daf23336691063.en: Receipt is confirmed on {{bank}}. The letter reached the public reception office later.
43daf23336691063.zh: 已确认于{{bank}}收到；函件较晚才送达公共接待处。

5dce1e37207b5e01.en: The refund period is tied to the creditor’s receipt of the application.
5dce1e37207b5e01.zh: 退款期限与债权人收到申请的时间有关。

8b70257544cbe27f.en: When did the bank receive the application?

6be9678f0ca9d519.en: Explains where to submit the application and the special refund period under the given conditions. Does not control the creditor’s money or promise that the rate will remain unchanged.
6be9678f0ca9d519.zh: 说明给定条件下应向谁提出申请，以及适用的特别退款期限。不支配债权人的资金，也不承诺利率不变。

38cc33f7df4e4304.en: Public reception specialist for financial-services consumer protection
38cc33f7df4e4304.zh: 金融服务消费者权益保护公共接待专员

cd92605817ee0f70.en: Check the application received by the creditor and the special refund deadline, separately explaining the need to examine the interest-rate terms.
cd92605817ee0f70.zh: 核查债权人收到的申请和特别退款期限，并另行说明需要审查利率条款。

13b2efdadfede48c.en: Send the citizen back and forth between the bank and insurer without analysing the contract.
13b2efdadfede48c.zh: 不分析合同，让公民在银行与保险公司之间来回奔波。

91aa6c4748739297.en: Guarantee the rate will remain unchanged without reading the terms.
91aa6c4748739297.zh: 不阅读条款就保证利率不变。

a2a252162752cf39.en: Distinguish the appeal-examination period from the special seven-working-day refund period under the case conditions.
a2a252162752cf39.zh: 区分来件办理期限与本案条件下的特别七个工作日退款期限。

6bb761351f4aecfb.en: Replace the special refund with a general reply.
6bb761351f4aecfb.zh: 用一般答复代替特别退款义务。

a14dd6f5e0d76d47.en: Assistant: “The bank may reply within 15 days, so it may also refund the money within 15.”
a14dd6f5e0d76d47.zh: 助手：“银行可以在15天内答复，所以也可以在15天内退款。”

256b2b1b6226542d.en: Confirm full early repayment and the link between the policy and the loan.
256b2b1b6226542d.zh: 确认贷款已全部提前清偿，并核实保单与贷款的关联。

ae18bdb9732b19b2.en: Distinguish the initial withdrawal period from a different basis for a refund.
ae18bdb9732b19b2.zh: 区分最初的退保期间与另一种退款依据。

d57f82d9b929be09.en: Prepare the basis for a proportional refund and its due date.
d57f82d9b929be09.zh: 准备按比例退款及确定履行日期的依据。

300a8ef7d5263acf.en: Do not promise the full premium or a specific amount without calculating the relevant period.
300a8ef7d5263acf.zh: 未计算相关期间前，不要承诺退还全部保费或具体金额。

3176e5fffe190ca9.en: Compare the insurer’s calculation with the actual period of coverage.
3176e5fffe190ca9.zh: 将保险公司的计算与实际保险期间进行比对。

b3cb0577481f01c8.en: Reject the claim solely because thirty days have elapsed.
b3cb0577481f01c8.zh: 仅因三十天已过就拒绝请求。

7d29525ad42d84b2.en: Require a full premium refund regardless of the period of coverage used.
7d29525ad42d84b2.zh: 不考虑已使用的保险期间，要求退还全部保费。

39fcfb9dd9e7ac73.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. An individual voluntary insurance contract was concluded to support a consumer loan. Ilya is both borrower and policyholder. Full early repayment is confirmed, and the insurance was intended to continue longer. There have been no events bearing signs of an insured event. The application follows full early repayment; it is not a withdrawal within the first 30 days. An exact monetary amount is not assessed without a complete calculation of the period.
39fcfb9dd9e7ac73.zh: 本案所有人物、文件及事件均为虚构。个人自愿保险合同是为保障消费贷款而订立的，伊利亚既是借款人，也是投保人。贷款全部提前清偿已获确认，而保险原计划继续有效更长时间。未发生具有保险事故特征的事件。申请是在贷款全部提前清偿后提出的，不是最初30天内的退保。未完整计算期间前，不评定确切退款金额。

3914279e154db513.en: Part 12 of Article 11 of Law No. 353-ФЗ. First identify the starting event.
3914279e154db513.zh: 353-ФЗ号法律第11条第12款。请先确定起算事件。

d42c9576edeb3671.en: Part 12 of Article 11 of Law No. 353-ФЗ

6385a6dd75bdcb4d.en: Expiry of the first thirty days does not answer the refund question after full early repayment. The basis and extent of the refund are different.
6385a6dd75bdcb4d.zh: 最初三十天届满，并不能回答全部提前清偿后的退款问题。退款的依据和范围不同。

897dd526c0a6b35e.en: The reply mentions only that thirty days have passed since the contract was concluded. Full early repayment and Part 12 of Article 11 are not considered.
897dd526c0a6b35e.zh: 答复只提到合同订立后已经过了三十天，没有审查全部提前清偿以及第11条第12款。

82cabca406cb1c9b.en: The loan obligations were fulfilled in full ahead of schedule on {{observed}}. This is not a partial reduction of the debt. Insurance contract ИС-27 supported that loan and was intended to continue.
82cabca406cb1c9b.zh: 贷款义务已于{{observed}}全部提前履行，并非仅部分减少债务。保险合同ИС-27保障的是该笔贷款，原本还应继续有效。

cf57cabf9a103d2a.en: The borrower is named as policyholder. The insurer received the refund application on {{recipientReceived}}. The premium relates to this policy; no insured events with the specified characteristics have been established.
cf57cabf9a103d2a.zh: 保单载明借款人为投保人。保险公司于{{recipientReceived}}收到退款申请。保费对应本保单，未查明发生具备规定特征的保险事故。

5f46ad4718560669.en: Policy and application to the insurer
5f46ad4718560669.zh: 保单及向保险公司提出的申请

05c1c14a39837349.en: The claim is based on full early repayment of the loan, not the initial withdrawal period. Expiry of the first thirty days does not answer the refund question after full early repayment. The basis and extent of the refund are different.
05c1c14a39837349.zh: 请求的依据是贷款全部提前清偿，而不是最初的退保期间。最初三十天届满，并不能回答全部提前清偿后的退款问题。退款的依据和范围不同。

6a477e3ed3177e63.en: The claim is based on full early repayment of the loan, not the initial withdrawal period.
6a477e3ed3177e63.zh: 请求的依据是贷款全部提前清偿，而不是最初的退保期间。

04ffc64dd0a87b59.en: Once thirty days have passed, no basis for any refund remains.
04ffc64dd0a87b59.zh: 一旦超过三十天，就不存在任何退款依据。

1e84bf89d19bf749.en: Full repayment always requires a full premium refund, regardless of the period during which coverage was in force.
1e84bf89d19bf749.zh: 全部还款后总应退还全部保费，无须考虑保险实际生效的期间。

655fcd1d11644db2.en: In its calculation, the insurer treated the policy’s entire original term as already elapsed, even though it has not yet ended.
655fcd1d11644db2.zh: 保险公司在计算时，把原定的整个保单期限都当作已经经过，尽管该期限尚未结束。

866b11700af080e4.en: Check the actual period of coverage and the calculation basis; the full planned term cannot automatically be treated as used.
866b11700af080e4.zh: 核查实际生效期间及计算依据，不能自动把全部计划期限当成已经使用。

620bef120bd4515d.en: Accept any calculation from the insurer without comparison.
620bef120bd4515d.zh: 不作比对，直接接受保险公司的任何计算。

3beea95530f87272.en: Award compensation for non-pecuniary harm and a penalty yourself on behalf of reception.
3beea95530f87272.zh: 以接待处名义自行裁定精神损害赔偿及罚金。

2aa5ada465d1e8d4.en: Refund the entire premium as though every withdrawal were within the first thirty days.
2aa5ada465d1e8d4.zh: 一律按最初三十天内退保处理，退还全部保费。

f3a87b640ebc5bdc.en: Consider refusal based on expiry of the initial thirty days sufficient.
f3a87b640ebc5bdc.zh: 认为以最初三十天已过为由拒绝请求就足够了。

6d505c5c883bbaf9.en: Find the legal basis for the following action: apply Part 12 of Article 11, under which the insurer refunds the premium after deducting the portion proportional to the period of coverage used.
6d505c5c883bbaf9.zh: 查找以下措施的法律依据：适用第11条第12款，由保险公司退款，并扣除与实际生效期间成比例的保费部分。

c0009840a7724133.en: I repaid the whole loan early after a few months. I am the policyholder in the policy. They told me that thirty days had passed, so nothing could be refunded.
c0009840a7724133.zh: 几个月后，我提前还清了全部贷款，保单中的投保人就是我。但他们说三十天已经过去，不能退任何钱。

ba37dec1e6efb96b.en: Examining a claim connected with full early repayment and individual insurance.
ba37dec1e6efb96b.zh: 审查与全部提前清偿及个人保险有关的请求。

9b7764ff4c0219b1.en: In full; this is confirmed for К-27.
9b7764ff4c0219b1.zh: 已全部清偿，К-27的材料对此作了确认。

d4d3b16f0de0d276.en: Was the loan repaid in full or only in part?
d4d3b16f0de0d276.zh: 贷款是全部清偿还是部分清偿？

fed5a6ffb1d62d56.en: A few months; some of the period remains.
fed5a6ffb1d62d56.zh: 已经过了几个月，但还有剩余期间。

79aee2e6ccdf19f2.en: How much of the insurance period has elapsed?
79aee2e6ccdf19f2.zh: 保险期间已经经过了多少？

f432078f9d418179.en: When did the insurer receive the application?
f432078f9d418179.zh: 保险公司何时收到申请？

17bbfd0aa3c2ca6b.zh: 负责金融服务来件的接待专员

b611d01112938499.en: The insurer under individual loan-supporting contract ИС-27.
b611d01112938499.zh: 贷款保障个人合同ИС-27项下的保险公司。
